questions.stem: Which property is typical of transition metals but NOT of Group 1 metals?

options.text: They form coloured compounds and have variable oxidation states
They are solid at room temperature

questions.explanation: Transition metals characteristically form coloured compounds (e.g., blue Cu²⁺, green Fe²⁺) and have variable oxidation states (e.g., Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺). Group 1 metals only form +1 ions and their compounds are white or colourless.
